decision: Core image pilot workflows exercised on real data. Accuracy improvement and superiority over 3LC are not established.

dataset.name: Official COCO 2017 person, image-license-filtered CC BY 2.0 subset
dataset.license_selection: Only COCO image license id 4 (CC BY 2.0); all original image source, Flickr, license and file SHA256 records retained.
dataset.rights_limit: COCO metadata was checked; original image rights were not independently reverified. COCO annotation licensing does not license every COCO photograph.
dataset.excluded_alternative: CrowdHuman: its official terms restrict use to non-commercial research and education.
dataset.split_policy: train and valid are disjoint subsets of official train2017; test is from official val2017 and is never used for selection or checkpoint choice.
dataset.complexity: Dense groups, small people, crowd regions, overlapping boxes and border-touching people. Overlap and border contact are geometric proxies, not ground-truth occlusion/truncation labels.

detection_experiment.metric: Official pycocotools COCO bbox AP at IoU .50:.05:.95, in points (0–100)
detection_experiment.selection: Same 400 person/100 negative training counts. Uniform SHA256 order versus half highest training-pool error scores plus half hashed samples; no human label corrections.
detection_experiment.crowd_policy: Both selection policies exclude training images containing crowd regions because YOLO training cannot mask ignored regions. Validation and test retain all official crowd annotations.
detection_experiment.conclusion: Error-guided selection regressed on average (two seeds worse, one better). Both three-epoch fine-tuning conditions scored below the untouched pretrained detector. Do not promote this recipe as an accuracy improvement.
detection_experiment.architecture_note: Ultralytics changes nc=80 to nc=1 for person-only fine-tuning. The untouched reference retains the 80-class head; only person predictions are evaluated.
detection_experiment.pretraining_note: YOLO weights were pretrained on full COCO train2017, which includes this qualification's training and validation pools. This is a workflow/fine-tuning qualification, not evaluation in a new domain.
detection_experiment.test_use: Training-pool predictions determine selection; validation chooses checkpoints. The six recipes were held fixed and test results were not used to tune them. The untouched reference was evaluated afterward for context.

classify.derived_task: Any annotated person, including a crowd region, versus no person

semantic.derived_task: Union of individual-person masks versus background; crowd pixels ignored
semantic.aggregation: Pooled class intersections/unions at original image resolution

additional_gpu_qualification.sam_limit: Ten largest-person ground-truth box prompts; selected examples, direct model adapter on GPU. This is not automatic detection or a general SAM quality benchmark.

embeddings.preprocessing: ImageNet normalization, RGB resize to 224 square

additional_gpu_qualification.limit: Classification and semantic tasks are derived engineering checks, not official COCO benchmark tasks. Single training seed. Mask and pose checks are pretrained inference only.

claims.evidence: 6 detection runs with 3 epochs, plus native classification and semantic API histories.
Six frozen 500-image selections; original 1000-image labels/weights unchanged; 500 matched test images in every comparison.
Real GPU inference and stored task metrics; editor and proposal recovery tested in a browser with deterministic model responses.
512-dimensional learned ResNet features, 200-image PCA reference reused on 80 test images; saved coordinates and identity preserved. Interactive rendering separately tested.

claims.claim: Better accuracy after this selection recipe
claims.evidence: Mean delta -2.6580 AP points across three paired seeds.

claims.claim: Faster annotation, reduced human effort, better than 3LC
claims.evidence: No timed human study and no matched 3LC execution.

claims.claim: Full platform parity or production scale
claims.evidence: Plugin SDK/managed environments, SAML, point clouds, retrieval operators, broad GPU/distributed frameworks and large-scale qualification remain.

environment.timing_limit: Shared development laptop with concurrent workloads. Timing and memory observations are descriptive, not isolated performance or competitor benchmarks.

reproduce: Use an empty --root for a new experiment; completed artifacts are preserved.
